name: Deore crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 740 g for the 170 mm FC-MT60 high-performance Biopace triple crankset with 48/38/28T chainrings, excluding the separately listed BB-MT60 bottom bracket. This is the Biopace reference identified by the manufacturer drawing, not a later round-chainring assembly.
